items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, we raised up together. Hamp, Milt Hinton, and myself. We was all raised up down on Rose Avenue.

ctx.x: Do you remember who was on that record with him?
I don't remember. All I remember, you know, is Hamp's playing on it. I'd have to look it up. And that's the only time you've ever heard it?

items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Knew Hamp, I was raised up with Hamp. ... we were both in the same neighborhood.

ctx.x: Beautiful record. Did you know Hampton was in Chicago?
Knew Hamp, I was raised up with Hamp.
